title: Aagaya shabaan
body:
Aagaya shabaan
Marhaba..
<<DIVIDER>>
Marhaba swalle a'laa
Aagaya shaban khushiyo'n ke zamane aagaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Rone wale mehfilo'n mein muskurane aagaye
Kaun aaya hai zamee'n par banke zeenat baap ki
<<DIVIDER>>
panjetan khud shauk mein jhoola jhulane aagaye
Pyaas bachpan mein bujhakar sheh ki ghazi ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhiye baba hame waade nibhane aagaye
May alam lekar chala to aayi ghazi ki sadaa
<<DIVIDER>>
ho mubarak ab tumhe baazu katane aagaye
Dekhne sidra se aagey ke manazir jibra'eel
<<DIVIDER>>
Fatema Zehra ke ghar chakki chalane aagaye
Shikwa qismat se na karna jaun se bole Husain
<<DIVIDER>>
ab to raazi hai tujhe hum khud manane aagaye
Qabr me pohcha jo momin aayi baali se sadaa
<<DIVIDER>>
aye farishto'n jao kyu isko jagane aagaye
Mai ne likkha tha fidak ki maalika tujhko salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaar mein kuch log mera ghar jalane aagaye
Dekhkar manzar najaf se karbala tak yu laga
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise qayam ki hukumat ke zamaney aagaye
Is jaha'n mein aye takallum hum faqeer e buturab
<<DIVIDER>>
dushman e zehra ko mitti mein milane aagaye
Marhabaa swalle a'laa
author: Mir Hassan Mir
